title: Fix SRD class proficiency boundary contamination
description:
Problem
The SRD importer emits class records whose proficiency fields are contaminated by class advancement tables and nearby feature prose.

Evidence from the 2026-06-07 audit
Affected class records include:
- class:bard
- class:cleric
- class:druid
- class:monk
- class:paladin
- class:ranger
- class:sorcerer
- class:warlock
- class:wizard

Example failure pattern
A class proficiency field such as armor or weapon proficiency should contain only the explicit proficiency list from the class prose, but instead continues into table text such as The
close_reason: Parser now stops proficiency continuation at the class level-progression table (title 'The <ClassName>' or a level-row cell); regenerated canonical pack. class-proficiency-bleed audit findings: 9 -> 0.
